description: Use when you need the native coin balance (ETH or POL) of an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: wei and a decimal amount from a public node, with the block number and as_of. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/native-balance, $0.001 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
name: evm_native_balance
title: EVM native balance
